description.raw: '''Innate:''' Scoring a champion [[File:Damage rating.png|20px|link=Takedown|An icon representing the keyword Takedown]] [[:Takedown|takedown]] within 3 seconds of damaging them will reduce the '''current''' cooldowns of '''Katarina's''' [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities]] by 15 seconds.
description.text: Innate: Scoring a champion takedown within 3 seconds of damaging them will reduce the current cooldowns of Katarina's abilities by 15 seconds.

description2.raw: '''Innate - Sinister Steel:''' Whenever '''Katarina''' retrieves a Dagger, she slashes around herself to deal 68 – 240 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] (+ 60% '''bonus''' AD) (+ 70% / 80% / 90% / 100% (based on level) AP) magic damage to nearby enemies, apply [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] effects to enemy champions hit, and reduce ''[[File:Katarina Shunpo.png|20xpx|border|link=Katarina#Shunpo|An icon for Katarina's ability Shunpo]] [[Katarina#Shunpo|Shunpo's]]'' '''current''' cooldown by 78% / 84% / 90% / 96% (based on level) of its '''total''' cooldown.
description2.text: Innate - Sinister Steel: Whenever Katarina retrieves a Dagger, she slashes around herself to deal 68 – 240 (based on level)Category:Debug (+ 60% bonus AD) (+ 70% / 80% / 90% / 100% (based on level) AP) magic damage to nearby enemies, apply on-hit effects to enemy champions hit, and reduce Shunpo's current cooldown by 78% / 84% / 90% / 96% (based on level) of its total cooldown.

description4.raw: Daggers grant [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of their radius and will disappear after being on the ground for 4 seconds.
description4.text: Daggers grant sight of their radius and will disappear after being on the ground for 4 seconds.

notes.raw: * ''Voracity's'' cooldown reduction will still take effect even after '''Katarina''' dies. * The Dagger's area of effect indicator is displayed even before it lands, although '''Katarina''' may not slash until it has. This can be targeted by [[File:Katarina Shunpo.png|20xpx|border|link=Katarina#Shunpo|An icon for Katarina's ability Shunpo]] [[Katarina#Shunpo|Shunpo]]. * Daggers will still deal damage but not apply on-hit effects if [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]]. They cannot be [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] nor can they be missed while '''Katarina''' is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]]. * Single-use on-hit effects, such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]], will apply to the closest target to '''Katarina''' when she uses a Dagger.
notes.text:
Voracity's cooldown reduction will still take effect even after Katarina dies.
The Dagger's area of effect indicator is displayed even before it lands, although Katarina may not slash until it has. This can be targeted by Shunpo.
Daggers will still deal damage but not apply on-hit effects if dodged. They cannot be blocked nor can they be missed while Katarina is blinded.
Single-use on-hit effects, such as Spellblade, will apply to the closest target to Katarina when she uses a Dagger.
